note: How a story is set by its script (src/lib/text/script.ts; read by script.test.ts on the web and by the apps' twins of the rule). Only the prose counts — Markdown, link targets and bare addresses are left out — and only the first 4000 characters of title + "\n\n" + story. `script`: cjk when Han, kana and Hangul characters (C) are at least the words of every other script (W), latin otherwise; a text with no letters at all (empty, digits or marks alone) takes `fallback` (cjk when absent; the writer passes its UI locale's, see `emptyByLocale`). `lang`: zh-TW for Han, ja when kana are a tenth or more of C, ko when Hangul outnumber the rest, en for a Latin-script text, null for no letters or a script we can't name. `latinMarks`: the UTF-16 indices of each U+2018 / U+2019 with a Latin letter immediately before and after it, which a CJK story sets in its Latin face.

cases.title: Grandma
cases.story: The water was too hot and the grind too fine, but it was the first morning that felt like mine. 阿嬤 said nothing, and poured me another cup.

cases.title: 外婆
